projects.title: Odontolabs
projects.description: Odontolabs is a web service for creating virtual clinical records for the Dentistry School of the UAC. Built with C# ASP.NET 8 on the backend and Vue on the frontend.

projects.title: FireWatch
projects.description: A web app that harmonizes 25 years of NASA satellite fire data (MODIS and VIIRS, 8M+ detections) into a consistent fire-activity record for Mexico, letting users select any area to explore its historical fire calendar, trends, recurrent wildfire zones and year-to-year comparisons, with PDF and CSV export. Built with a Python data pipeline, a FastAPI + DuckDB API and a Vue 3 frontend for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

projects.title: ML Tree
projects.description: A machine learning model to classify an image of a tree within 11 species of the Yucatan Peninsula.

projects.title: PC Shop ETL & BI Dashboard
projects.description: A Python ETL pipeline with a star schema (fact and dimension tables) loaded through SSIS into a SQL Server Data Warehouse, including date and currency normalization, automated product-vs-service classification and referential integrity validation. The Power BI dashboard consolidates 1,247 tickets, 306 products and 1.5M in revenue (2022-2026), showing a 64/36 product-service split and sales peaks in January and August.

projects.title: Imprenta Campechana Dimensional Model
projects.description: A Python ETL pipeline that extracts transactional data from Apache Derby (JDBC/JPype) into a star schema, plus automated PDF technical documentation. The Power BI dashboard covers 120 orders and 1.9M in sales, with KPIs for average ticket (15,814), sales vs. collected, top clients and supply costs. It revealed that only 39% of orders were delivered on time, a problem that was not tracked before.

projects.title: Banxico ETL Pipeline
projects.description: A daily ETL pipeline that pulls USD/MXN exchange-rate data from the Banco de México (Banxico) API, processes it, and publishes an updated chart of the dollar value every day. Deployed on AWS with CloudFront.

projects.title: Pegasi Detecter
projects.description: Exoplanet detector powered by a Gradient Boosted Tree machine learning model, built with Python, Flask, and Vue for the frontend.

projects.title: Stationery POS
projects.description: A point-of-sale system for a stationery store (fictional client): product and inventory management, sales registration, and checkout. React frontend with a separate backend API.

projects.title: Class Booker
projects.description: A room reservation web service for the UAC, where teachers can book rooms in advance through an interactive calendar. Built with Spring on the backend and Vue on the frontend.
